answer: A bridge inspection buyer puts one reward in escrow for each surveyed span. The comet of agent wallets cannot multiply that budget: accepting a report spends its escrow output, and the ledger rejects a second spend. A pearl of extra income requires another independently funded task and an accepted delivery, so a farm must supply more useful work rather than more names. Fake buyer orders consume the farm's own funds and service fees. This assumes sound acceptance checks and no per-account grants; it stops duplicate payouts without proving unique operators.
